method: Independently observed the two actual durable original PNGs once each, before any modern drawing or previous modern spec/history was read.

sourceFacts: Four long, solid, approximately horizontal field lines in one shared frame, ordered top to bottom, each with a rightward terminal arrowhead. No vertical field lines, axes, tick marks, units, charge symbols or numerical field values.
The field-vector label E with a small rightward vector mark is above the right end of the top line.
Two filled circular points are on the second field line. Point 1 is left of point 2; labels 1 and 2 are below their corresponding points.

A heavier rightward displacement arrow runs from point 1 toward point 2 on the second field line, with its head immediately before/at point 2. It is aligned with the rightward field arrows, not a fifth independent field line.
The displacement label is capital delta followed by vector d, above the interior of the point-1-to-point-2 span.
No given numerical length, potential, work, force or charge sign appears. The four row gaps and point spacing are schematic, not calibrated.

stableBindings.requirement: Four source field arrows in a shared frame
Two source points, labels and directed along-field displacement

modernAdditions: Clean deterministic strokes, regularized row spacing, enlarged point markers and labels, and semantic color roles. These are noncalibrated layout choices, not physical measurements.
No additional instructional/answer labels. Mathematical vector notation and the source labels 1 and 2 are retained.

sourceFacts: Five long solid field lines run left to right across the frame, with a rightward arrowhead at the right end of every line. The source lines are nearly horizontal, with slight drawing/projection slant.

Five narrow, near-vertical, interrupted/broken plane traces are arranged left to right. Each extends above the top field line and below the bottom field line and intersects all five field lines: 25 projected crossings.
The traces have small solid pieces and dashed/broken stretches; they are not complete outlined parallelograms or filled rectangular sheets. No plane corners or closed plane borders are visible.

The only textual label is vector E, above the right end of the top field line. No named points, point dots, plane labels, charges, numerical potentials, units, distance scale or right-angle square appears.

The frozen lesson identifies these traces as the projected representation of parallel equipotential planes of a uniform field. That physical interpretation comes from the prose; pixel lengths/gaps and projected angles are not a physical calibration.

stableBindings.requirement: Five source broken projected plane traces
Every plane intersects every field line in the shared projected frame

modernAdditions: Regularized spacing, clean slightly oblique projected traces, consistent broken-line style and enlarged vector E. No new plane borders, dots, labels or physical values.
Finite segment endpoints and crossing coordinates are noncalibrated drawing coordinates. Their assertions check the projection's topology and parallelism only.
Physical normality is carried by the complete frozen prose. No perpendicular screen-coordinate assertion or measured right-angle glyph is used: projection need not preserve physical angles.
This is a field/plane projection, not a Cartesian measured grid. No axes, cell units, gridDimensions claim or objectCount substitute is introduced.
